prompt: Goal: reduce end-of-day food waste in a small market without discounts, loyalty points, surprise bags, donations, or asking staff to forecast demand. Selected direction: each prepared item is paired with a later item whose preparation is cancelled automatically when the first remains unsold, so unsold stock changes tomorrow's production sequence rather than today's price. The owner needs a concept that can be tested at one counter in two weeks.

Goal: reduce isolation among older adults living alone without volunteer visits, check-in calls, friendship matching, classes, companion robots, or collecting personal profiles. Selected direction: three local shops split ordinary home deliveries into two handoffs, so the resident completes a small verification with the second shop before the delivery is closed. The service must not turn delivery staff into informal welfare monitors.

Goal: prevent unresolved outpatient follow-ups from disappearing without adding a dashboard, meeting, transcription step, or new coordinator role. Selected direction: the physical specimen container carries a removable duty tab that can only be cleared by the person accepting the next action; uncleared tabs return with the daily transport crate. The clinic needs a legally defensible record but has not decided whether tab IDs may be copied into the existing chart.

Goal: help teenagers form durable local friendships without a matching service, app, points, supervised social event, mentorship programme, or personal-data collection. Selected direction: teenagers may claim maintenance responsibility for one public tool by signing its repair log; overlapping repair periods create repeated contact without staff assigning people to each other. Two library staff must be able to run it safely.

Goal: reveal real trade-offs in a neighborhood planning session without voting, token allocation, breakout groups, an expert panel, or extending the ninety-minute meeting. Selected direction: every proposal is admitted only after its advocate names one currently protected benefit it may reduce; proposals that name the same sacrificed benefit are discussed together. The facilitator needs a decision-ready operating concept.

Goal: develop a year-long drama inside one ordinary apartment building without surveillance technology, secret recordings, crime, haunting, trapped residents, or an unreliable reveal. Selected direction: residents reserve shared rooms by surrendering future access to another room, and the building's changing access map becomes evidence of promises and betrayals. The concept must create interpersonal choices without turning the map into a way to track individuals.

Goal: develop a pocket travel toy that stays interesting across many journeys without screens, electricity, collectible pieces, fictional companions, adult facilitation, or disposable refills. Selected direction: a sealed mechanical surface stores only the sequence of turns and stops from the last journey, changing which channels can be opened on the next one. The team must choose whether the memory should decay automatically or be reset deliberately.

Goal: help a five-person research team choose risky experiments without scoring proposals, adding a dashboard, or holding another recurring meeting. Selected direction: each proposal names the observable result that would make a different proposal preferable, and experiments are sequenced through these cross-trigger conditions. The team needs to know whether this is genuinely different from an implicit ranking system.
목표: 오래된 상가의 여름 냉방 전력을 줄이되 점포별 순위, 포인트, 벌금, 경품, 사용량 대시보드, 교육 캠페인은 쓰지 않는다. 선택한 방향: 각 점포가 냉방 시작을 15분 미룰 때마다 공용 복도의 냉방 가능 시간이 늘어나며, 관리인은 총 공용 시간만 표시한다. 점포별 기여량을 기록하지 않고도 실제로 운영 가능한 컨셉으로 발전시켜야 한다.
목표: 혼자 사는 주민이 동네에서 반복적으로 마주칠 계기를 만들되 친구 매칭, 정기 안부전화, 봉사자 방문, 취미교실, 개인정보 수집은 하지 않는다. 선택한 방향: 세탁소·철물점·약국이 완결되지 않은 생활 심부름을 다음 손님에게 넘기고, 원래 손님이 나중에 결과를 확인한다. 참여자의 안전과 상점의 반복 업무를 포함해 구체화해야 한다.
목표: 성인에게 통계적 불확실성을 20분 안에 가르치되 강의, 퀴즈, 예측 게임, 동전 던지기, 컴퓨터 시뮬레이션은 쓰지 않는다. 선택한 방향: 참가자가 서로 다른 실제 주장에 하나의 긴 종이 띠를 나누어 범위를 표시하고, 한 주장의 범위를 좁히면 다른 주장의 설명 공간이 줄어든다. 이 방향의 오해 가능성과 교사의 실제 운영을 검토하라.
목표: 작은 공방을 닫는 두 장인이 공개 행사, 기념품, 방명록, 사진 전시, 손님의 연설, 감정 표현 강요 없이 마지막 정리를 마치게 한다. 선택한 방향: 마지막 주에 수리 불가능한 공구의 쓸 수 있는 부분만 분해해 현재 진행 중인 작업에 사용하고, 남은 부품은 평소 폐기 절차로 처리한다. 의식이 업무를 방해하지 않게 구체화하라.

Goal: develop a negotiation mechanic for a tabletop narrative game without dialogue trees, hidden dice, persuasion statistics, secret information, or a moderator. Selected direction: each party places one future action it will permanently lose onto a shared board, and agreement exists only where the remaining action sets overlap. The prototype must make consequences legible before commitment.

Goal: let a small museum rotate fragile objects through study access without a booking app, priority score, extra committee, or first-come queue. Selected direction: every approved request inherits one unresolved conservation task from the prior request, and access transfers only when that task is accepted by the next researcher. Develop the ordinary workflow, refusal, failure response, and falsifier.
목표: 두 층 사이 계단참에서만 성립하는 반복 경험을 만들되 카메라, 센서, 앱, 거울 착시, 비밀문, 상주 진행자는 쓰지 않는다. 선택한 방향: 지나가는 사람이 발판의 실제 무게 균형을 바꾸면 다음 사람이 선택할 수 있는 손잡이 위치가 달라진다. 비상 통행과 유지관리까지 포함해 컨셉을 발전시켜라.
목표: 예약, 번호표, 대기 앱, 멤버십 우선권 없이 작은 식당의 혼잡한 점심 대기를 줄인다. 선택한 방향: 손님은 자리를 기다리는 대신 아직 조리가 시작되지 않은 메뉴의 준비 순서를 서로 교환할 수 있고, 주방은 교환된 순서만 공개한다. 공정성, 반복 운영, 실패 대응과 다음 실험을 포함한 컨셉 메모가 필요하다.
